name: Alert
description: Monitoring notification concerning a server or instance.

name.label: Name
name.help: Enter a concise name for the alert.

status.label: Status
status.description: Current delivery status of the alert.
status.help: Indicates whether the alert is pending or sent.

alert_policy_id.label: Alert policy
alert_policy_id.help: Select the policy whose triggers generated this alert.

server_id.label: Server
server_id.help: Select the server concerned by the alert.

instance_id.label: Instance
instance_id.help: Select the instance concerned by the alert.
